next.reason: 1985 pointer: the indexed FILE STATUS clause is the sequential one and its content is the I-O status. 2023 has one organization-neutral FILE STATUS clause (§2023:12.4.5.8.2, in Format 1 (indexed) of §2023:12.4.5.1); §2023:12.4.5.8.4 GR1 'updated to contain the value of the I-O status for the file connector referenced by the subject of the entry'. The imported sequential syntax rules are carried by the 1985 VII FILE STATUS records, not this pointer; 2023 SR3-SR4 concern new features.
